image_description: A close-up view of a classic car wheel mounted on a black vehicle. The wheel features a whitewall tire with visible tread and sidewall texture, mounted on a black steel rim with a polished silver lip. A chrome hubcap covers the center, featuring a central emblem and simulated or real lug nut covers. The surrounding black fender reflects the environment, indicating a glossy finish.
